executive_summary: Five isolated hypotheses were tested from one source commit. All selected outputs, actual gates, installed sources and 65-scenario regressions were independently checked. Timings are preliminary local evidence.

methodology.platform: Mac ARM64, Colima linux/amd64 through Rosetta

scope_and_risk.cost: Low: logging-level guards; callbacks preserve enabled DEBUG text.
limits: Component rendering avoided at disabled DEBUG; practical verdict uses full runs.
